g.text: Data model: the CDC log, the current table and run metadata

text.tspan: Delta tables under s3a://cdc-demo (the SQL Server path writes the same tables under s3a://cdc-demo/mssql).
PK: the key the dbt unique and unique-combination tests check. Dashed arrow: the column a row refers to;
no foreign key is enforced. Selected columns; the full lists are in the schema modules.
